channels.name: Washington State Department of Ecology (sewage spills)
channels.legal_basis: RCW 90.48.636(1): Ecology "must post on the website notice of the reported sewage spill" for every sewage spill "reported to the department under individual water quality permits for discharges that contain sewage"; content RCW 90.48.636(1)(a)-(g), final information within a reasonable time after the spill ends (2); RCW 90.48.632 defines a sewage spill
channels.note: Ecology's statutory list of sewage spills reported under individual permits (public or private), live since mid-2026: start, end once known, volume, level of treatment, location and the area potentially affected, with a link to the operator's report. Read through the table's public layer, which answered the project user agent on 2026-11-04. Ecology aims to post within five working days; the statute sets no deadline. No coordinates; no CSO events from operators' routine wet-weather reports were seen apart from one. (research/wa/report.md §2.2)

channels.name: Washington State Department of Ecology (sewage spill alerts)
